description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity that displays a grid of application icons on the screen. It dynamically loads installed apps that can be launched and presents up to 32 app icons in a GridView, using a custom adapter defined within the activity.

classes.name: LayoutAnimation6
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a grid of app icons, loading installed launcher activities and using a custom adapter for display.

classes.name: LayoutAnimation6.AppsAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to provide views (ImageViews) for each app icon in the grid.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads the list of launchable apps, and sets up the GridView with the custom adapter.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Queries the package manager for all activities that can handle the launcher intent, storing them in mApps.

methods.name: AppsAdapter.getView
methods.description: Creates or recycles an ImageView for the app at the specified position, setting the app icon and size.

methods.name: AppsAdapter.getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items to display, capped at 32 or the total number of apps if less.

methods.name: AppsAdapter.getItem
methods.description: Returns the ResolveInfo object for the app at the given position, wrapping around if necessary.

methods.name: AppsAdapter.getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the item ID.
